- Do you want a 30-, 45- or 60-minute slot? For regulated workloads we recommend 45 to cover architecture + evidence Q&A.

I attached our short pre-demo checklist (no sensitive docs) — it outlines what evidence we can surface during the session and what we need after the call for a gated pilot.

- Tue 21 Jun, 6:00–6:45pm PT
- Wed 22 Jun, 7:00–7:45pm PT
